ValidationRule.description: Can't request to move a contact to an account they are already listed at
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
RecordType.Name ="Move Contact" && ISPICKVAL(Status__c ,"Not Started") &&
Contact__r.Account.Name = Move_to_Account__r.Name
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This contact is already listed at this account. Please input a different account to switch the contact to.
